top_signals.title: Trump’s Foes Find Common Ground at Modi’s New Delhi Summit
top_signals.summary: Leaders of emerging powers including Russia and Iran projected a united front at a weekend summit in New Delhi, with a joint statement that targeted a US-launched war in the Middle East, Washington’s tariff campaign and its sanctions policy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Number of Vessels Redirected in US Blockade on Iran Reaches 100
top_signals.summary: US forces have redirected 100 commercial vessels over the past 60 days since the blockade against Iran resumed, the Central Command says in an update on X.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The long shadow of quantitative easing
top_signals.summary: Central bank balance sheets will stay large
